ratings.note: Very nice modern house, well defined front and backyard. Large living/kitchen area, nicely arranged 3 bedrooms and bathrooms. A bit small for all 6 of us. It's in the village, so extension may have permit restrictions. Wexford, the county seat is about 30 minutes drive
Very close proximity of a few other houses. Steep stairs. Larger field is not in the immediate vicinity of the house.

Beautiful secluded place, great for dogs and remote work. Hard to commute from, and get medical care. Need to find the actual boundaries under the trees. About 30 minutes drive to Kilkenny (nothing after Cupertino or even Tucson)

Promising, but not enough information about ground plan and heating. House is very close to a main road and probably too small. About 15 minutes to Kilkenny (schools and hospital). Need to verify the boundaries, but seems to have a large field behind the house. The Listing talks about 18.5 acres! If it comes with the property, it is more of a problem than advantage - unless it can be rented out. Bathroom drain attached to the house from outside. The grounds are way too "industrial", needs to be dealt with.

Very good location, reasonable yard. House is reasonable size, but in quite bad condition. Even its structural integrity is questionable. Requires extensive remodeling. The Masterplan (2023) leaves the property intact, envisions a primary school and large green area next to it. However, predicted construction is 2028-2031.  Once it grows through, increases the value of the property significantly.

Imposing building, mostly fenced yard. Easy commute, large enough village to provide most everything. Steep stairs to the 1st floor. Ground floor has hard to use floorplan. Living room and kitchen are accessible only through dining room. Very close to train line, in particular to the station (trains stopping and starting)

Fenced backyard (sheeps!), large enough property. Very few and small windows. Hard to build a bathroom in ground floor, unless we give up the pantry. Outbuildings to do something with them (other than sheep).
Large, connected backyard, but the house is right on the roads. Plenty of bedrooms.
